title: Why the decision to drop Mohammad Siraj has raised an uproar
text:
Why the decision to drop Mohammad Siraj has raised an uproar - The Times of India toi Sign In Why the decision to drop Mohammad Siraj has raised an uproar
 Team TOI Plus 
 TIMESOFINDIA.COM Updated: Nov 20, 2026, 20:27 IST IST 
 Fans and former cricketers were united in the criticism to drop the pacer from the first Test against New Zealand. The first day’s play seemed to prove them right and has raised uncomfortable questions
 Looking at Team India’s bowling combination for the first Test against New Zealand at the Basin Reserve, many commentators and fans felt logic was missing from the decision-making process. The decision to exclude Mohammad Siraj on a seaming pitch, possibly giving New Zealand an opportunity to claw back into the game, has raised many questions, some of them uncomfortable.
In an innings where India’s standout bowler was a rejuvenated Jasprit Bumrah , one had to question the rationale to drop Siraj given the two fast bowlers have complemented each other before. There’s also the fact that Siraj has been India’s leading wicket-taker in the ongoing World Test Championship cycle, with 43 wickets.
